title: White tigers in Mall World?
content: Hello everyone, new here! Fascinated to have been directed here! I regularly dream in these elaborate, maze-like environments with seemingly unending connected rooms and spaces, beyond what I even consider myself able to imagine. I'm almost always looking for someone or something, mostly feeling lost or confused but simultaneously in a familiar place. Most of the times I feel stressed and anxious, feelings of being chased -- it's rarely positive for me. This particular dream, I had a couple nights ago, has stuck with me because, for the first time, I actually faced the thing I was running from -- a white tiger. I was in this massive house, dimly lit and full of nature breaking in. Dark corners full of overgrowth and vines, like something out of The Last of Us. I was with my family and we were looking for a place to settle in for a moment but a white tiger would pop out of a dark corner or another room. Everytime I rushed to block it's entrance, it would come from somewhere else behind me. I spent the entire dream trying to block off all the possible entrances to no avail. I just found it so weird because the tiger was so vivid in my dream and I've never encountered my "assailant" face to face, and never imagined it'd be an animal.
